messages:
alex: FYI starting POC with Nimbus Health. they want a lightweight hosted trial org for a 2-week eval, demo Wed.
carol-se: what resources do they need? dedicated or hosted?
alex: hosted only. asks: 50k token credits, project spend cap $800, limit models to gen-family, rate limit 30rpm, ephemeral admin key for demo.
ben-sec: security asks: webhook callbacks must be IP allowlisted and logs retention 14d. also need confirmation that telemetry strips PHI.
carol-se: we can enable telemetry with PHI redaction per standard presales flow. will note redaction rules.
infra-bot: Reminder: requests for spend caps < $1k can be approved by finance lead, no PO required. See /ops/billing-policy.
dana-finance: @alex please confirm org name and contact email to attach credits. credits are non-refundable and expire in 30 days unless otherwise approved.
alex: org id: nimbus-trial-2026, contact: linda@nimbushealth.com (linda-customer). Linda needs admin key for demo and access to logs.
carol-se: plan: create org + one project `nimbus-demo`, attach 50k token credits, set spend cap $800, set model filter to gen.*, set rate limit 30rpm, enable ephemeral admin key TTL 12h, add webhook IP allowlist. logs retention 14d, telemetry PHI redaction.
carol-se: internal command I will use:
```
/infra-provision --org nimbus-trial-2026 --owner linda@nimbushealth.com --project nimbus-demo --credits 50000 --spendcap 800 --expiry 30d --rate 30rpm --models gen.* --ephemeral-ttl 12h
```
alex: please also enable ephemeral keys to be delivered via secure vault and share link with Linda.
dana-finance: approved. recording: "Nimbus trial credits 50k tokens, expire 30d, spend cap $800, org nimbus-trial-2026".
ben-sec: confirm ephemeral key scope limited to project-level and tokens are not logged in plaintext.
carol-se: confirmed. keys scoped project-only, logs redact secrets.
linda-customer: thanks team, will be on demo Wed 10am PT. need access 2h before demo for smoke test.
carol-se: ETA for provisioning ~1.5h. I'll notify when ready and include secure link for the key.
alex: action items:
- carol-se: provision org/project/ephemeral key + IP allowlist (ETA 1.5h)
- dana-finance: attach approval to billing record (done)
- ben-sec: confirm telemetry redaction settings (in progress)
- alex: send demo invite and smoke test checklist to Linda

alex: thanks all, please post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
